text: Wave 2 was dispatched while this study's own scoring loop was running. Scoring copies a four-gigabyte template per replayed patch, which held the one-minute load average above the frozen ceiling of 8 for the full 900-second admission window, and both wave-2 guard-off runs were refused by the load guard with 'load stayed above 8.0 for 900s (last 15.64)'. Neither produced a manifest and no outcome was taken from either. The scheduler was stopped, scoring was allowed to finish, and wave 2 was re-run on a quiet machine. The frozen ceiling was not raised.

The first verdict recorded for r-9b915d475334fbe2 claimed two guard firings and a false alarm. Both came from the scorer recovering the rule id out of the rule's own test file, which the candidate had read. The recovery pattern was anchored to the guard's own diagnostic shape, the row was withdrawn to evidence/withdrawn-verdicts.jsonl, and the run was re-scored as never-duplicated with zero firings. No published number was ever taken from the withdrawn row.
